description: The 100-service fixture bench (flisk-sh/flisk-erp-system) booted on a clean GitHub-hosted runner (moved from the retired erp-scale-e2e workflow, #1301): flisk project and doctor, flisk up, then every backend answering /health through Traefik, and the report with the time to all backends healthy. The full boot runs nightly and manual (e2e-scale-full.yml): it builds about 107 images. The merge queue gate (e2e-scale.yml) sets SCOPE=smoke and boots 5 services.
